features.name: Battelle Darby Creek Nature Center
features.description: Battelle Darby Creek Nature Center is the park's 14,000-square-foot visitor building with interactive natural and cultural exhibits and a 53-foot living stream stocked with native Darby watershed life.
features.source_label: Columbus and Franklin County Metro Parks

features.name: Bison Pastures
features.description: Battelle Darby Creek's bison roam two enclosed pastures near the Nature Center and Darby Creek Greenway, with public views that change as the herd moves between winter and summer grazing areas.
features.source_label: Columbus and Franklin County Metro Parks
